# Independent course review decision replay

Eight sanitized cases cover normal consumption, repeated integration failure,
due idea reconsideration, incomplete composition, legitimate goal change,
duplicate settled review, inaccessible evidence and biased review preparation.
No private project data or task history is included.

The baseline is exact framework 1.34.1; the candidate is the current working
instruction tree. This is a proposed behavioral comparison, not evidence of
runtime or product success. Freeze both variants and these inputs before calls.
Use prepare-framework-eval.mjs with the explicit suite option:

    {fixture: "tests/fixtures/course-review", baselineVersion: "1.34.1"}

Run conditions must be matched: same model/effort, tool access, output bound and
per-attempt budget. Fresh contexts cannot read the rubric, arm mapping, prior
answers or producer discussion. Alternate arm order using the existing stager.
Actual family names in installed docs may reveal the variant; blinding limits
must be reported rather than claiming perfect blindness.

The rubric is reviewer-only and source-grounded. A distinct judge must cite
answer evidence and keep UNKNOWN when evidence is absent; do not infer execution.
Count false stops, missed obligations, unnecessary private-context expansion,
duplicate work, retained outcomes and total input/cached/output/time including
evaluation overhead. Price estimates do not establish subscription allowance.

No model budget is authorized by these files. Staging creates 16 trial folders
but invokes zero models. A separately approved subset may start with C01-C04
(four matched pairs), without silently treating unrun C05-C08 as passed.
No automated release or product adoption follows from a green decision screen.
